name: Red Leather Bandanas
summary: At Sentinel Hill, Red Leather Bandanas mark the Defias fight. Scout Galiaan seeks the red masks worn by outlaws as the People's Militia struggles to track them across Westfall.

sections.title: A Mark of Allegiance
sections.body: Across Westfall, a red bandana marks the Defias Brotherhood. Cutpurses, looters, and traitors from many walks of life join the gang, then rally beneath the same crimson sign. At Sentinel Hill, Scout Galiaan and the People's Militia collect the cloth as proof that bandits have fallen. The bandanas also help them follow the Defias as its fronts shift across the countryside.

sections.title: The Militia's Scouting Efforts
sections.body: Stormwind has denied Westfall proper military support, leaving the People's Militia to chart Defias activity with seasoned observers like Scout Galiaan. From Sentinel Hill, Galiaan watches outlaw patrols and tracks their movements. Passing adventurers and militia volunteers take on the dangerous work of bringing down the highwaymen who drove honest farmers from their land.

faq.q: Why do the Defias wear red leather bandanas?
faq.answer: The red leather bandana marks allegiance to the Defias Brotherhood and hides the identities of former laborers, thieves, and outlaws. It also strikes fear into Westfall's remaining farmers.
Scout Galiaan serves in the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill. He tracks the Defias Brotherhood's movements and shifting fronts across Westfall, and coordinates bounties to curb outlaw activity.

faq.q: Why does the Militia need adventurers to collect these bandanas?
faq.answer: The People's Militia is stretched thin, without royal soldiers or funding from Stormwind. Bounties give scouts like Galiaan proof of fallen bandits and help weaken the Defias while Sentinel Hill stays defended.

faq.q: Where are the bandits carrying these bandanas found?
faq.answer: Defias outlaws roam nearly every corner of Westfall. They occupy abandoned farmsteads, prowl the crossroads, and camp along the Gold Coast and around the Moonbrook hills.

faq.q: What happens to the bandanas after you turn them in?
aliases: what does galiaan do with bandanas
faq.answer: Scout Galiaan uses the bandanas as proof of fallen outlaws. They help him track shifting Defias fronts and gauge how the militia's campaigns affect the Brotherhood's numbers in the region.

faq.q: Is the Stormwind Army involved in this bounty?
faq.answer: No. Stormwind's military has largely left Westfall to focus on other internal troubles. Local defense rests with Gryan Stoutmantle and the volunteer People's Militia.

angles.text: As an ally of the People's Militia, you help defend Westfall while Stormwind's royal leadership sends no aid.
As a rogue, you see how Defias highwaymen have joined beneath crimson masks to form an army on Stormwind's doorstep.
